# OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT asset

Unmodified original: `chatgpt-logo-white.svg`.

Source: https://developers.openai.com/assets/siwc/sign-in-buttons/chatgpt-logo-white.svg

The official [Sign in with ChatGPT documentation](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/website) references this asset for sign-in buttons. Retrieved 2026-11-07. The Android drawable preserves its original 21×21 viewport and path; it does not alter the Bugu Notes application icon or identity. OpenAI names and marks remain subject to OpenAI’s branding guidance and are not relicensed by this project's MIT license.
